errors.evidence: Hello search_agent, please help find the official USGS record or publication which details the first documented occurrence of the American Alligator found west of Texas (excluding Texas). In particular, we need the year this occurrence was recorded. Please provide as much context and the specific year mentioned in the USGS source. Thank you.
errors.description: The agent fabricated a tool output by assuming the search_agent would provide the correct year from the USGS record.
